input.rationale: The fee articles (Article V user-fee tiers, Supplemental Payments, rebate shares) contain no best-price or best-terms undertaking by Licensee, so pricing is clean. The one MFN-family obligation burdening us is Article XXII: we must disclose any bona fide third-party offer for our assets or control and then afford Licensor five business days to take that transaction on the same terms — a right-to-match/most-favoured-offer mechanic in Vendor's favour. It is not limited to a defined product, runs for the whole term (36 months plus extensions, far beyond 12 months) and has no like-for-like comparison carve-outs, so it fails every fallback element and is walk-away territory. We therefore take the preferred position: the disclosure and matching mechanic is replaced with a short confirmation that no right of first refusal or matching right runs in Licensor's favour, and the surviving Customer-favourable sentence is conformed so Article XXII reads as one self-standing provision with no orphan reference to the deleted "Right of First Refusal" or "Exercise Period" (confirmed those terms and "Article XXII" appear nowhere else). The separate Article XX Change of Control consent regime and Article XXIV(c) assignment consent are left untouched, so nothing outside this rule is disturbed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have replaced Article XXII's disclosure and right-to-match mechanic with a short confirmation that no right of first refusal or matching right runs in Licensor's favour, as our playbook accepts no most-favoured-nation or matching obligation benefiting the Vendor. We conformed the following sentence so Article XXII reads as one self-standing provision with no reference to the deleted mechanic; the Change of Control consent regime in Article XX is untouched.

ops.oldText: ARTICLE XXII RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL During the term of this Agreement, the Licensor shall have the right (the "Right of First Refusal"), for a period (the "Exercise Period") expiring at 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on the fifth (5th) business day after the giving of written notice by the Licensee that it has received a bonafide offer from a third party to (ii) purchase all or substantially all of the assets of Licensee; or (ii) to engage in a merger or consolidation in which Licensee is not the surviving corporation or in which, if Licensee is the surviving corporation, the owners of Licensee immediately prior to the consummation of such merger or consolidation do not, immediately after consummation of such merger or consolidation, own stock or other securities of Licensee that possess a majority of the voting power of all Licensee's outstanding stock and other securities and the power to elect a majority of the members of Licensee's board of directors.
ops.newText: ARTICLE XXII TRANSFERS Licensee may sell all or substantially all of its assets, or engage in any merger or consolidation, with any third party without notice to, or any right of first refusal or matching right in favor of, Licensor.
